# semaphore_ex_project_inventories (Data Source)

Lists accessible project inventories without modifying them. Pagination is completed before filtering, and failures never produce partial results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_inventories" "available" {
  project_id = 1
}

output "available_ids" {
  value = data.semaphore_ex_project_inventories.available.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `name_filter` (String) Exact, case-sensitive match on name. Omit to include every accessible record.
- `type_filter` (String) Exact match on the API's type field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity derived from the collection scope and filters.
- `ids` (List of Number) Matching IDs in deterministic ascending order.
- `items` (Attributes List) Identity and non-secret summary fields. Use the singular data source for complete details. Missing metadata remains null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `revision` (Number)
- `type` (String)
